report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis of deployment-caused checkout errors. Traces show all checkout, order, inventory, payment, and save_order spans returning 200 with ok results. Order metrics show /v1/orders 200s on version 1.0.0 and zero 502s; version 2.0.0 shows no traffic. The only deployment record is baseline-order-v1 (1.0.0), which cannot establish deployment-caused latency. No bounded fault is substantiated, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or traces showing non-200 checkout/order responses to confirm any checkout error exists
Deployment records for version 2.0.0 or any rollout overlapping the incident window
Metrics for checkout service itself (not only order) to localize errors
Evidence of latency or error onset timing relative to any deployment
